Overview

Rome is a city in Lazio with a population of 2,873,000. The Eternal City, where 2,500 years of history meet modern Italian life with ancient ruins, Renaissance art, and world-famous cuisine. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
